label: Tag, index and offset
subgoals: Take log base two of the block size for the offset
Divide capacity by block size times associativity for the sets
Assign the remaining address bits to the tag

label: Associativity changes the split
subgoals: Halve the set count when associativity doubles
Move one bit from the index to the tag
Charge one tag comparator per way

label: Total storage
subgoals: Count the lines as capacity over block size
Add data, tag, valid and dirty bits per line
Multiply by the number of lines
